blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 Key Concepts
blocks.en: Key Concepts

blocks.zh: §11.1(b) 的兩個觸發條件：
blocks.en: The two triggers in §11.1(b):

blocks.zh: 條件 1：記錄是電子形式（非紙本），且符合以下任一操作：建立、修改、維護、存檔、檢索、傳輸。
blocks.en: Condition 1: The record is in electronic form (not paper) and is subject to any of the following operations: creation, modification, maintenance, archiving, retrieval or transmission.

blocks.zh: 條件 2：這個電子記錄是「在 FDA 法規要求下」（predicate rule）才觸發。
blocks.en: Condition 2: The electronic record is only caught when it is kept "under FDA regulations" (the predicate rule).

blocks.zh: 排除條款（重要！）： 「紙本記錄的電子傳輸」不適用 Part 11。例：紙本批次記錄掃描成 PDF 寄給品保部門 → 那個 PDF 不是「電子記錄」，只是紙本的電子副本，Part 11 不適用。
blocks.en: Exclusion (important!): The "electronic transmission of paper records" is not covered by Part 11. Example: a paper batch record is scanned to PDF and sent to Quality Assurance → that PDF is not an "electronic record"; it is merely an electronic copy of paper, and Part 11 does not apply.

blocks.zh: §11.1(e) 查廠意涵 Inspection Implications
blocks.en: §11.1(e) Inspection Implications

blocks.zh: §11.1(e) 賦予 FDA 查廠官員檢查 Part 11 系統的完整權力——包括硬體、軟體、系統文件（驗證文件、SOP、存取控制清單）。這意味著 FDA 查廠不只看生產記錄，也可以要求：
blocks.en: §11.1(e) gives FDA investigators full authority to inspect Part 11 systems, including hardware, software and system documentation (validation documents, SOPs, access control lists). This means an FDA inspection does not look only at production records; investigators may also request:

blocks.zh: 系統驗證報告（IQ/OQ/PQ）
blocks.en: System validation reports (IQ/OQ/PQ)

blocks.zh: 使用者帳號清單及權限設置
blocks.en: User account lists and permission settings

blocks.zh: 稽核追蹤記錄
blocks.en: Audit trail records

blocks.zh: 系統 SOP 和管理員手冊
blocks.en: System SOPs and administrator manuals

blocks.zh: 備份和災難復原測試記錄
blocks.en: Backup and disaster recovery test records

blocks.zh: 1.2 §11.2 — Implementation 1.2 §11.2 — 實施
blocks.en: 1.2 §11.2 — Implementation

blocks.zh: §11.2 的兩種記錄類別：
blocks.en: The two record categories under §11.2:

blocks.zh: 類別 A — 內部維護記錄（不提交 FDA）： eBR、LIMS、SCADA 數據。僅需符合 Part 11 本身的要求。這是 CDMO 最常遇到的情況。
blocks.en: Category A: internally maintained records (not submitted to FDA): eBR, LIMS and SCADA data. These only need to meet the requirements of Part 11 itself. This is the situation a CDMO encounters most often.

blocks.zh: 類別 B — 電子提交 FDA 的記錄： eCTD（電子通用技術文件）、電子 IND、電子 NDA/BLA。除符合 Part 11 外，還需確認 FDA 接受電子提交的特定記錄類型（docket 92S-0251 清單）。
blocks.en: Category B: records submitted electronically to FDA: eCTD (electronic Common Technical Document), electronic IND, electronic NDA/BLA. In addition to meeting Part 11, you must confirm that FDA accepts electronic submission of that specific record type (the docket 92S-0251 list).

blocks.zh: 對大多數製造型 CDMO 而言，日常操作記錄屬於類別 A。客戶的法規提交材料屬於類別 B（通常由客戶和法規事務部門處理，不是生產端的事）。
blocks.en: For most manufacturing CDMOs, day-to-day operating records fall under Category A. Clients' regulatory submission materials fall under Category B (usually handled by the client and its regulatory affairs department, not by the manufacturing side).

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 Analogy
blocks.en: Analogy

blocks.zh: §11.2(a) 就像你的「內部財務記帳」——只要符合公司內部規定和稅法，怎麼記都可以。§11.2(b) 就像「向國稅局申報的稅表」——除了要合規，還要用國稅局規定的格式和申報管道。
blocks.en: §11.2(a) is like your "internal bookkeeping": as long as it complies with company policy and tax law, you can keep the books however you like. §11.2(b) is like a "tax return filed with the tax authority": besides being compliant, you must use the format and filing channel the tax authority prescribes.

blocks.zh: 1.3 §11.3 — Definitions 1.3 §11.3 — 定義
blocks.en: 1.3 §11.3 — Definitions

blocks.zh: 三種「簽名」類型辨析
blocks.en: Distinguishing the Three Types of "Signature"

blocks.zh: 1. Electronic Signature（電子簽名）： 最廣義。任何電腦資料組合（符號序列），被個人執行/採用/授權作為其手寫簽名的法律等效物。包含 ID+密碼組合、數位憑證、生物特徵等。
blocks.en: 1. Electronic signature: The broadest term. Any computer data compilation of any symbol or series of symbols executed, adopted or authorized by an individual to be the legally binding equivalent of the individual's handwritten signature. It includes ID + password combinations, digital certificates, biometrics and so on.

blocks.zh: 2. Digital Signature（數位簽名）： 電子簽名的子集。基於密碼學方法（非對稱加密、PKI）。既能驗證簽名者身份，也能驗證文件完整性（任何竄改都會使簽名無效）。Part 11 在開放系統（§11.30）要求使用。
blocks.en: 2. Digital signature: A subset of electronic signatures, based on cryptographic methods (asymmetric encryption, PKI). It can verify both the identity of the signer and the integrity of the document (any tampering invalidates the signature). Part 11 requires its use in open systems (§11.30).

blocks.zh: 3. Handwritten Signature Executed to Electronic Record（手寫簽名執行至電子記錄）： 用手寫板在電子設備上手寫的簽名。保留了手寫簽名的筆跡，但媒介是電子設備。Part 11 也規範這類簽名（當簽到電子記錄上時）。
blocks.en: 3. Handwritten signature executed to electronic record: A signature written by hand on an electronic device using a stylus pad. It preserves the handwriting of the signature, but the medium is an electronic device. Part 11 also regulates this type of signature (when signing an electronic record).

blocks.zh: Biometric 定義的實務意涵
blocks.en: Practical Implications of the Biometric Definition

blocks.zh: §11.3(c) 對 biometric 的定義強調兩個條件：（1）對個人是唯一的；（2）可量測的。
blocks.en: The definition of biometrics in §11.3(c) stresses two conditions: (1) unique to an individual; (2) measurable.

blocks.zh: 符合條件的生物特徵：指紋、視網膜/虹膜掃描、臉部識別、聲紋、筆跡動態（不只是結果，而是簽名的速度/壓力/筆順）。
blocks.en: Qualifying biometrics: fingerprints, retina/iris scans, facial recognition, voiceprints, and handwriting dynamics (not just the result, but the speed/pressure/stroke order of the signature).

blocks.zh: 不符合條件（或爭議性）：僅有靜態掃描的簽名圖像（可複製，不唯一）。
blocks.en: Not qualifying (or debatable): a static scanned image of a signature (it can be copied and is not unique).

blocks.zh: 生物特徵電子簽名適用 §11.200(b)，不需要雙重認證元素，但必須確保「只有真正的持有人才能使用」。
blocks.en: Biometric electronic signatures fall under §11.200(b) and do not need two distinct identification components, but you must ensure they can "be used only by their genuine owners".

blocks.zh: Closed vs. Open System 判定 Key Concepts
blocks.en: Determining Closed vs. Open System: Key Concepts

blocks.zh: 判定關鍵：WHO controls access？
blocks.en: The key test: WHO controls access?

blocks.zh: 封閉系統 (Closed System) = 負責電子記錄內容的人（通常是公司的 IT/品保）控制系統存取。
blocks.en: Closed system = the persons responsible for the content of the electronic records (usually the company's IT/QA) control system access.

blocks.zh: 開放系統 (Open System) = 存取由「對記錄內容不負責的他方」控制。
blocks.en: Open system = access is controlled by "parties other than those responsible for the content of the records".

blocks.zh: 1.4 Closed vs. Open System — Practical Implications 1.4 封閉系統與開放系統 — 實務意涵
blocks.en: 1.4 Closed vs. Open System — Practical Implications

blocks.zh: 封閉系統： 就像你公司的內部保險庫——公司控制鑰匙和進出名單。即使保險庫在外面的建築物裡，只要你控制誰能進去，就是「封閉」的。
blocks.en: Closed system: Like your company's own internal vault: the company controls the keys and the entry list. Even if the vault is in an outside building, it is still "closed" as long as you control who can get in.

blocks.zh: 開放系統： 就像把文件放在公共圖書館——即使你有一個上鎖的格子，圖書館管理員（第三方）也有總鑰匙，可以進入任何格子。這就是「開放」的本質。
blocks.en: Open system: Like leaving documents in a public library: even if you have a locked compartment, the librarian (a third party) has a master key and can open any compartment. That is the essence of "open".

blocks.zh: 雲端系統的 Part 11 挑戰
blocks.en: Part 11 Challenges of Cloud Systems

blocks.zh: SaaS 系統（如 Veeva Vault、MasterControl、LabVantage）的常見做法：
blocks.en: Common practice for SaaS systems (such as Veeva Vault, MasterControl, LabVantage):

blocks.zh: 供應商提供：(1) 系統驗證支援套件（IQ/OQ 協議）；(2) SOC 2 Type II 審計報告（第三方安全評估）；(3) 合約條款保證存取控制和審計追蹤功能。
blocks.en: The vendor provides: (1) a system validation support package (IQ/OQ protocols); (2) a SOC 2 Type II audit report (third-party security assessment); (3) contract terms guaranteeing access control and audit trail functionality.

blocks.zh: 藥廠（CDMO）負責：(1) 供應商資格確認（Vendor Qualification）；(2) 補充 PQ（效能確認）測試 Part 11 特定功能；(3) 風險評估：系統如何分類（封閉 vs 開放）以及如何確保加密傳輸。
blocks.en: The pharmaceutical company (CDMO) is responsible for: (1) vendor qualification; (2) supplementary PQ testing of Part 11-specific functions; (3) a risk assessment covering how the system is classified (closed vs. open) and how encrypted transmission is ensured.

blocks.zh: FDA 查廠時，兩種論述都可能被接受，但必須有書面風險評估和相應控制措施。
blocks.en: During an FDA inspection, either position may be accepted, but a documented risk assessment and corresponding controls must be in place.

blocks.zh: 實務應用 Practical Application (CDMO Focus)
blocks.en: Practical Application (CDMO Focus)

blocks.zh: 系統分類決策樹（Amaran Biotech 應用）：
blocks.en: System classification decision tree (Amaran Biotech application):

blocks.zh: 步驟 1：識別誰控制使用者帳號（系統管理員在哪裡？）
blocks.en: Step 1: Identify who controls user accounts (where are the system administrators?)

blocks.zh: 步驟 2：識別資料傳輸路徑（純內網 vs 透過公共網路？）
blocks.en: Step 2: Identify the data transmission path (internal network only vs. through a public network?)

blocks.zh: 步驟 3：如果是雲端系統，評估廠商合約中的存取控制條款
blocks.en: Step 3: If it is a cloud system, evaluate the access control terms in the vendor contract

blocks.zh: 步驟 4：記錄分類決策及理由（書面風險評估）
blocks.en: Step 4: Document the classification decision and rationale (documented risk assessment)

blocks.zh: 步驟 5：根據分類決定需要哪些額外控制（加密？數位簽名？）
blocks.en: Step 5: Based on the classification, decide which additional controls are needed (encryption? digital signature?)

blocks.zh: 步驟 6：在系統驗證文件（URS、風險評估）中記錄系統分類
blocks.en: Step 6: Record the system classification in the validation documents (URS, risk assessment)

blocks.zh: 本章重點總結
blocks.en: Chapter Summary

blocks.zh: §11.1 排除條款： 紙本記錄的電子傳輸（掃描、PDF 寄送）不受 Part 11 規範——記錄必須「以電子形式建立/維護」才適用。
blocks.en: The §11.1 exclusion: Electronic transmission of paper records (scanning, sending PDFs) is not subject to Part 11; the record must be "created/maintained in electronic form" for Part 11 to apply.

blocks.zh: 封閉 vs 開放系統由存取控制歸屬決定： 技術（內網/雲端）不是判斷標準；決定因素是「負責記錄內容的人是否控制系統存取」。
blocks.en: Closed vs. open systems are determined by who controls access: Technology (internal network/cloud) is not the criterion; the deciding factor is whether "the persons responsible for the content of the records control system access".

blocks.zh: 三種簽名類型要分清： 電子簽名（最廣）⊃ 數位簽名（加密方法，用於開放系統）；手寫簽名執行至電子記錄（手寫板）也受 Part 11 規範。
blocks.en: Keep the three signature types apart: electronic signature (broadest) ⊃ digital signature (a cryptographic method, used in open systems); handwritten signature executed to electronic record (stylus pad) is also regulated by Part 11.

blocks.zh: 開放系統需要額外控制： 在 §11.10 的 11 項控制基礎上，還需加密和數位簽名標準（§11.30）——保護傳輸過程中的機密性和完整性。
blocks.en: Open systems need additional controls: On top of the 11 controls in §11.10, they also need encryption and digital signature standards (§11.30), to protect confidentiality and integrity during transmission.
